Title: Const declaration
Code: const name = "Alice";
Explain: Declares a constant variable holding a string value.

Title: Let with number
Code:
let count = 42;
count += 1;
Explain: Declares a mutable variable and increments it by one.

Title: Boolean flag
Code:
const isReady = true;
const isComplete = false;
Explain: Declares two boolean constants representing state flags.

Title: Template literal
Code:
const user = "Bob";
const greeting = `Hello, ${user}!`;
Explain: Uses a template literal to embed a variable inside a string.

Title: Array literal
Code:
const colors = ["red", "green", "blue"];
const first = colors[0];
Explain: Creates an array of strings and accesses the first element by index.

Title: Object literal
Code:
const point = { x: 10, y: 20 };
const sum = point.x + point.y;
Explain: Creates a simple object with two numeric properties and sums them.

Title: Simple function
Explain: Defines a function that returns the sum of two parameters.
Calls the function and logs the result to the console.

Title: If-else check
Explain: Defines a function that checks whether a number is even.
Uses the modulo operator and strict equality inside an if-else block.

Title: For loop sum
Explain: Sums all integers from 1 to n using a for loop.
An accumulator variable collects the running total.

Title: String method chain
Explain: Trims whitespace and converts a string to lowercase.
Demonstrates chaining common string transformation methods.

Title: While loop countdown
Explain: Counts down from a starting number to 1 using a while loop.
Prints each number and then prints Go when the loop ends.

Title: Array map and filter
Explain: Filters an array to keep only even numbers.
Maps over the filtered results to double each value.
Demonstrates chaining array methods with arrow functions.

Title: Reduce to object
Explain: Uses reduce to count occurrences of each fruit in an array.
The accumulator is an object where keys are fruit names and values are counts.

Title: Spread and rest
Explain: Merges a defaults object with any number of override objects.
Uses rest parameters to collect overrides and spread to merge them.

Title: Ternary and nullish coalescing
Explain: Formats a user object into a display string.
Uses nullish coalescing for defaults and ternary for conditional labels.

Title: Closure counter
Explain: Creates a counter object that closes over a private value variable.
The returned methods can read and modify the enclosed state.

Title: Class with inheritance
Explain: Defines a base Shape class with an abstract-like area method.
Circle extends Shape and provides a concrete area implementation.
Demonstrates constructor chaining with super.

Title: Promise chain
Explain: Creates a promise-based function that simulates an async lookup.
Chains two sequential lookups using .then and handles errors with .catch.

Title: Destructuring and defaults
Explain: Uses parameter destructuring with defaults to configure a server.
Returns an object with a listen method that logs the server address and routes.

Title: Map and Set usage
Explain: Uses a Set to track seen items and a Map to count duplicates.
Converts Map entries into an array of objects with occurrence counts.

Title: Iterator protocol
Explain: Implements the iterable protocol by defining Symbol.iterator on a class.
The returned iterator yields values from start to end with a given step.

Title: Async/await with error handling
Explain: Implements a fetch wrapper with configurable retry logic.
Uses exponential backoff by multiplying delay by the attempt number.
Rethrows after exhausting all retries.

Title: Generator function
Explain: Defines an infinite Fibonacci generator.
Composes take and map generators for lazy sequence processing.
Only materializes values when spread into an array.

Title: Complex closure with memoization
Explain: Creates a generic memoization wrapper using closures and a Map cache.
Supports a custom key resolver and exposes cache management methods.
The second call returns the cached result without recomputing.

Title: Event emitter implementation
Explain: Implements a custom event emitter with on, once, emit, and off methods.
Uses a Map to store arrays of listener objects with a once flag.
Supports method chaining via returning this.

Title: Async generator pipeline
Explain: Builds an async processing pipeline using async generators.
readChunks yields array slices with simulated async delay.
transform applies a mapping function to each chunk, and collect gathers all results.

Title: Proxy-based validation
Explain: Uses a Proxy to intercept set, get, and deleteProperty operations.
Validates types and custom constraints on assignment.
Prevents deletion of required properties.

Title: Symbol-based private state
Explain: Uses Symbol keys to hide internal state and reducer from external access.
Implements a Redux-like store with dispatch, subscribe, and unsubscribe.
Freezes returned state to prevent direct mutation.

Title: Promise.allSettled with concurrency
Explain: Implements a concurrency-limited async map using a worker pool pattern.
Each worker grabs the next available index in a while loop.
Errors are captured per-item so one failure does not abort the batch.

Title: WeakRef and FinalizationRegistry
Explain: Builds a cache that holds weak references to values, allowing garbage collection.
FinalizationRegistry cleans up Map entries when objects are collected.
The size getter prunes stale entries on access.

Title: AbortController and async race
Explain: Wraps any promise with a timeout using Promise.race and AbortController.
Returns the abort function and signal for external cancellation.
Cleans up the timeout if the original promise resolves first.

Title: Async middleware pipeline
Explain: Implements a Koa-style async middleware pipeline with next() dispatch.
Each middleware can run code before and after calling next.
Guards against calling next() multiple times with an index check.

Title: Reactive observable system
Explain: Implements a minimal RxJS-style Observable with subscribe, pipe, from, and interval.
Operators map, filter, and take are higher-order functions returning new Observables.
Each operator properly forwards error and complete signals and returns teardown logic.

Title: Dependency injection container
Explain: Implements a dependency injection container with factory registration.
Supports singleton lifetime, dependency resolution, and circular dependency detection.
createScope produces a child container that inherits registrations.
